items.title: Parvat Manthan Conclave calls for climate-resilient planning
items.one_liner: The Parvat Manthan Conclave 2026 urged climate-resilient planning and municipal finance in Himalayan cities.
items.why: Directly relevant to mountainous, data-scarce, and risk-prone urban environments comparable to Kabul.
items.action: Look for summary reports or policy briefs emerging from the conclave regarding mountainous municipal planning.

items.title: Türkiye looks beyond reconstruction to build disaster-ready cities
items.one_liner: Türkiye is focusing its policies on building disaster-ready cities rather than simple post-disaster reconstruction.
items.why: Informs long-term urban planning, hazard mitigation, and settlement resilience in seismic or conflict-affected regions.
items.action: Examine Türkiye's policy shift for integration into frameworks dealing with vulnerable settlement typologies.

items.title: Germany opens funding for municipal biodiversity strategies
items.one_liner: Germany has opened new funding opportunities aimed at supporting municipal biodiversity strategies.
items.why: Provides practical context for municipal-level funding mechanisms supporting urban green infrastructure and biodiversity planning.
items.action: Investigate the eligibility and thematic focus of this funding call for comparative insights.

items.title: Strategy for Brazilian cities proposes expanding nature-based solutions
items.one_liner: A new strategy for Brazilian cities proposes expanding the use of nature-based solutions for urban planning.
items.why: Offers a Global South perspective on scaling up nature-based solutions to enhance urban resilience and ecosystem services.
items.action: Review the Brazilian strategy document to extract transferable governance and planning frameworks.

items.title: IUCN operational framework for nature-based solutions
items.one_liner: IUCN released an operational framework for integrated, community-led nature-based solutions for adaptation.
items.why: Provides methodological guidance on inclusive, community-level environmental planning and ecosystem adaptation.
items.source: International Union for Conservation of Nature
items.action: Download and read the IUCN operational framework to evaluate its indicators for local service delivery.

items.title: One Bangkok highlights urban green space as resilience blueprint
items.one_liner: One Bangkok showcased its urban green space initiative as a model for city-scale resilience.
items.why: Connects high-density Asian urban development with practical delivery of urban cooling and nature access.
items.action: Examine the design metrics and performance data of this urban green space blueprint.

items.title: Cities at COP31: Recognition Without Resources
items.one_liner: Discussions at COP31 highlighted that cities receive international climate recognition without adequate financial resources.
items.why: Highlights the governance and municipal finance gaps affecting local climate adaptation and urban green infrastructure.
items.action: Note the financing constraints highlighted for urban climate action when analyzing municipal governance limitations.

items.title: Can L.A. County transform its flood control channels into parks?
items.one_liner: Los Angeles County is exploring the transformation of concrete flood control channels into multi-use parks.
items.why: Illustrates stormwater management retrofits that link runoff retention with urban cooling and public green space access.
items.action: Review the engineering and spatial trade-offs discussed in converting gray infrastructure to green-blue networks.

note: Selected updates, not comprehensive coverage. Status is unverified unless supported by the quoted official excerpt.
